title: Director at Semiconductor Assembly and Testing Provider Expects Healthy Marvell Growth From 800G Optical DSPs and AI Custom ASICs
expert: Director, Marvell NPI at a semiconductor assembly and test provider (OSAT), current
verdict: An OSAT director running Marvell NPI saw Marvell packaging shipments up 38%-48% y/y (8%-12% q/q) in Aug-Oct 2026, about 5% above plan, on 800G optical DSPs and AI custom ASICs, but expects growth to slow to 15%-25% y/y in Nov-Jan.

Custom program roster and scope: AI custom ~50% of adv-pkg demand [13 • Expert Call](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-268732&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse15355&hl=fse15355,fse18284&page=2)
Margins: 8-15% capacity gap; lead times flat [8 • Expert Call](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-268732&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse11487&hl=fse11487,fse11548,fse11916,fse20954,fse21130&page=2)

changes: Capacity gap with flat lead times vs mgmt acutely constrained (SB #59559): consistent

new_datapoints.text: Marvell packaging shipments at OSAT +38%-48% y/y and +8%-12% q/q in Aug-Oct 2026, ~5% above expectations
Marvell NPI/pre-production activity at OSAT +18%-25% q/q in Aug-Oct 2026
AI/custom compute ~50% and traditional networking ~20% of Marvell advanced-packaging demand at OSAT
Advanced-packaging prices for Marvell +5%-10% y/y; wire-bond networking packaging flat
Advanced-packaging capacity gap 8%-15% (CoWoS/2.5D, ABF); lead times flat vs 90 days ago; capacity booked ~half a year ahead
OSAT expects Marvell growth 15%-25% y/y in Nov 2026-Jan 2027 and 15%-25% in 2027
Marvell optical packaging growth 35%-45% next 12 months, 25%-35% in 2027 depending on 1.6T
Broadcom leads Marvell by 10%-15% share in traditional large DC and some top CSP custom AI chips; Marvell design-win share +5%-8% over two quarters
